title: gtm-tools
description: A read-only verified record of agent-operable GTM tools: search, fetch, compare, track changes.
summary: A read-only verified record of agent-operable GTM tools: search, fetch, compare, track changes.
offersHint: A read-only verified record of agent-operable GTM tools: search, fetch, compare, track changes. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.gtmtools.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_tools
toolsPreview.description: Search the verified GTM-tools directory. Filter by keyword, category, tier (BADGE|listed|DEMOTE), verifiedOnly, or mcpOnly; sort by score (default), name, or g2. Returns ranked slim results. Use category + sort=score for 'best in category'.

toolsPreview.name: get_tool
toolsPreview.description: Get one GTM tool by name or slug, with verified status (real last_checked_at), curation, product signals, adoption, and verified review themes.

toolsPreview.name: compare_tools
toolsPreview.description: Compare two GTM tools head-to-head. Returns both full records plus a per-axis diff (overall score, API quality, GTM relevance, curation score, ease of use, free tier) naming the winning slug or 'tie'.

toolsPreview.name: list_changes
toolsPreview.description: Recent detected changes to tracked tools (pricing, reachability, free-tier, deprecation), newest first. Optionally filter by kind.
